parameters.toolDescription: Mengambil KPI operasional satu merchant pada tanggal tertentu, meliputi total order, jumlah pembatalan, cancel rate, order terkirim, dan SLA 30 menit. Input: merchant_id dan tanggal. Jika tanggal kosong, gunakan hari data terakhir H8Mart
parameters.query:
WITH parameter AS (
    SELECT
        $1::text AS merchant_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF($2::text, '')::date,
            (SELECT hari_data_terakhir
             FROM core.data_info
             LIMIT 1)
        ) AS tanggal_laporan
)

SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.name AS nama_merchant,
    p.tanggal_laporan,

    COUNT(o.order_id)::integer AS total_order,

    COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (
        WHERE o.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
    )::integer AS order_batal,

    COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (
        WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    )::integer AS order_terkirim,

    COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (
        WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
        AND d.actual_minutes <= d.promised_minutes
    )::integer AS order_tepat_waktu,

    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            100.0 * COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (
                WHERE o.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
            ) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id), 0),
            2
        ), 0
    ) AS cancel_rate_pct,

    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            100.0 * COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (
                WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
                AND d.actual_minutes <= d.promised_minutes
            ) / NULLIF(
                COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (
                    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
                ), 0
            ),
            2
        ), 0
    ) AS sla_30_menit_pct

FROM parameter p
JOIN core.merchants m
    ON m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id

LEFT JOIN core.orders o
    ON o.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
    AND o.order_date = p.tanggal_laporan

LEFT JOIN core.deliveries d
    ON d.order_id = o.order_id

GROUP BY
    m.merchant_id,
    m.name,
    p.tanggal_laporan;

parameters.toolDescription: Mengambil lima alasan pembatalan pesanan teratas berdasarkan merchant dan tanggal, beserta jumlah pembatalan dan contoh catatan pelanggan. Gunakan merchant_id seperti M001 atau M003. Nilai ALL hanya untuk ringkasan operasional seluruh merchant pada WF1 Daily Digest. Jika tanggal kosong, gunakan hari data terakhir.
parameters.query:
WITH parameter AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM($1::text)), 'ALL'),
            ''
        ) AS merchant_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM($2::text), '')::date,
            (
                SELECT hari_data_terakhir
                FROM core.data_info
                LIMIT 1
            )
        ) AS tanggal_laporan
),

alasan AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(o.cancel_reason), ''),
            'tidak_diketahui'
        ) AS alasan_batal,

        COUNT(*)::integer AS jumlah_pembatalan,

        MIN(
            LEFT(
                NULLIF(TRIM(o.customer_note), ''),
                200
            )
        ) AS contoh_catatan_pelanggan

    FROM core.orders o
    CROSS JOIN parameter p

    WHERE o.order_date = p.tanggal_laporan
      AND o.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
      AND (
          p.merchant_id IS NULL
          OR o.merchant_id = p.merchant_id
      )

    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(o.cancel_reason), ''),
            'tidak_diketahui'
        )
)

SELECT
    p.tanggal_laporan,
    COALESCE(
        p.merchant_id,
        'ALL'
    ) AS merchant_id,

    a.alasan_batal,
    a.jumlah_pembatalan,

    COALESCE(
        a.contoh_catatan_pelanggan,
        'Tidak ada catatan pelanggan'
    ) AS contoh_catatan_pelanggan

FROM alasan a
CROSS JOIN parameter p

ORDER BY
    a.jumlah_pembatalan DESC,
    a.alasan_batal ASC

LIMIT 5;

parameters.toolDescription: Memeriksa stok produk milik merchant tertentu berdasarkan merchant_id dan SKU opsional. Mengembalikan nama produk, SKU, jumlah stok, status stok, dan waktu sinkronisasi terakhir. Gunakan ALL untuk menampilkan seluruh produk merchant. Hanya membaca data PostgreSQL.
parameters.query:
WITH parameter AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) AS merchant_id,
        NULLIF(
            NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM($2::text)), 'ALL'),
            ''
        ) AS sku
)

SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.name AS nama_merchant,
    p.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.name AS nama_produk,
    p.category AS kategori,

    COALESCE(s.qty, 0) AS stok_tersedia,

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(s.qty, 0) = 0
            THEN 'habis'
        WHEN COALESCE(s.qty, 0) <= 2
            THEN 'tipis'
        ELSE 'cukup'
    END AS status_stok,

    s.synced_at AS terakhir_sinkron

FROM parameter prm

JOIN core.merchants m
    ON m.merchant_id = prm.merchant_id
   AND m.active = TRUE

CROSS JOIN core.products p

LEFT JOIN core.merchant_stock s
    ON s.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
   AND s.product_id = p.product_id

WHERE
    prm.sku IS NULL
    OR p.sku = prm.sku

ORDER BY
    p.sku

LIMIT 30;
